001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 65,
009    displayName = "Bolus Requested 2/3",
010    internalName = "LID_BOLUS_REQUESTED_MSG2",
011    usedByAndroid = true,
012    usedByTidepool = true
013)
014public class BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
015    
016    private int bolusId;
017    private int options;
018    private int standardPercent;
019    private int duration;
020    private int spare1;
021    private int isf;
022    private int targetBG;
023    private boolean userOverride;
024    private boolean declinedCorrection;
025    private int selectedIOB;
026    private int spare2;
027    
028    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog() {}
029    
030    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int options, int standardPercent, int duration, int spare1, int isf, int targetBG, boolean userOverride, boolean declinedCorrection, int selectedIOB, int spare2) {
031        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, options, standardPercent, duration, spare1, isf, targetBG, userOverride, declinedCorrection, selectedIOB, spare2, 0);
032    }
033
034    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int options, int standardPercent, int duration, int spare1, int isf, int targetBG, boolean userOverride, boolean declinedCorrection, int selectedIOB, int spare2, int headerHighNibble) {
035        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, options, standardPercent, duration, spare1, isf, targetBG, userOverride, declinedCorrection, selectedIOB, spare2, headerHighNibble);
036        this.pumpTimeSec = pumpTimeSec;
037        this.sequenceNum = sequenceNum;
038        this.bolusId = bolusId;
039        this.options = options;
040        this.standardPercent = standardPercent;
041        this.duration = duration;
042        this.spare1 = spare1;
043        this.isf = isf;
044        this.targetBG = targetBG;
045        this.userOverride = userOverride;
046        this.declinedCorrection = declinedCorrection;
047        this.selectedIOB = selectedIOB;
048        this.spare2 = spare2;
049    }
050
051    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog(int bolusId, int options, int standardPercent, int duration, int spare1, int isf, int targetBG, boolean userOverride, boolean declinedCorrection, int selectedIOB, int spare2) {
052        this(0, 0, bolusId, options, standardPercent, duration, spare1, isf, targetBG, userOverride, declinedCorrection, selectedIOB, spare2);
053    }
054
055    public int typeId() {
056        return 65;
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * <table border="1">
061     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog:</caption>
062     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>options</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>standardPercent</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>duration</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>spare1</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>isf</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>targetBG</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>userOverride</code></td><td><code>raw[22] != 0</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>declinedCorrection</code></td><td><code>raw[23] != 0</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>selectedIOB</code></td><td><code>raw[24]</code></td></tr>
072     * <tr><td><code>spare2</code></td><td><code>raw[25]</code></td></tr>
073     * </table>
074     */
075    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
076        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
077        this.cargo = raw;
078        parseBase(raw);
079        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
080        this.options = raw[12];
081        this.standardPercent = raw[13];
082        this.duration = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
083        this.spare1 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
084        this.isf = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
085        this.targetBG = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
086        this.userOverride = raw[22] != 0;
087        this.declinedCorrection = raw[23] != 0;
088        this.selectedIOB = raw[24];
089        this.spare2 = raw[25];
090        
091    }
092
093    
094    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int options, int standardPercent, int duration, int spare1, int isf, int targetBG, boolean userOverride, boolean declinedCorrection, int selectedIOB, int spare2) {
095        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, options, standardPercent, duration, spare1, isf, targetBG, userOverride, declinedCorrection, selectedIOB, spare2, 0);
096    }
097
098    /**
099     * <table border="1">
100     * <caption>Byte layout for BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
101     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
102     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
103     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
105     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
106     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
108     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
109     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
110     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
111     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
112     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>(byte) options</code></td></tr>
113     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>(byte) standardPercent</code></td></tr>
114     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(duration) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
115     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(duration) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
116     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(spare1) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
117     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(spare1) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
118     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(isf) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
119     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(isf) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
120     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(targetBG) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
121     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(targetBG) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
122     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>(byte) (userOverride ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
123     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>(byte) (declinedCorrection ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
124     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>(byte) selectedIOB</code></td></tr>
125     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>(byte) spare2</code></td></tr>
126     * </table>
127     */
128    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int options, int standardPercent, int duration, int spare1, int isf, int targetBG, boolean userOverride, boolean declinedCorrection, int selectedIOB, int spare2, int headerHighNibble) {
129        return Bytes.combine(
130            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(65, headerHighNibble),
131            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
132            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
133            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId), 
134            new byte[]{ (byte) options }, 
135            new byte[]{ (byte) standardPercent }, 
136            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(duration), 
137            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(spare1), 
138            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(isf), 
139            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(targetBG), 
140            new byte[]{ (byte) (userOverride ? 1 : 0) }, 
141            new byte[]{ (byte) (declinedCorrection ? 1 : 0) }, 
142            new byte[]{ (byte) selectedIOB }, 
143            new byte[]{ (byte) spare2 });
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * @return bolus ID
148     */
149    public int getBolusId() {
150        return bolusId;
151    }
152    /**
153     * @return the raw value of the options byte, see {@link #getBolusOption()}
154     */
155    public int getOptions() {
156        return options;
157    }
158
159    /**
160     * @return how the bolus was requested, or null if the raw value is not recognized
161     */
162    public BolusOption getBolusOption() {
163        return BolusOption.fromId(options);
164    }
165
166    /**
167     * How the bolus was requested.
168     *
169     * <p><b>Value names ported from the tconnectsync Python implementation.</b> Only
170     * {@link #BLE_STANDARD} (4) has been confirmed on the wire so far (see
171     * <a href="https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/51">issue 51</a>): in a capture of
172     * 156 boluses initiated over BLE by a remote app ({@code InitiateBolusRequest}; the paired
173     * {@link BolusDeliveryHistoryLog} reported {@code bolusSource = 8}), 156/156
174     * LID_BOLUS_REQUESTED_MSG2 records carried {@code options = 4} together with
175     * {@code standardPercent = 100}, {@code duration = 0}, {@code userOverride = true} and
176     * {@code isf = targetBG = 0}. The remaining values are still tconnectsync-sourced and
177     * unverified: no record committed to this repository exercises them, so confirm against a
178     * capture before relying on those labels.
179     */
180    public enum BolusOption {
181        STANDARD(0),
182        EXTENDED(1),
183        QUICK(2),
184        AUTOMATIC(3),
185        /** Verified on the wire: 156/156 BLE-initiated boluses in the issue 51 capture. */
186        BLE_STANDARD(4),
187        BLE_EXTENDED(5),
188        EATING_SOON_AUTOMATIC(6),
189        LATE_BOLUS(7),
190        ;
191
192        private final int id;
193        BolusOption(int id) {
194            this.id = id;
195        }
196
197        public int id() {
198            return id;
199        }
200
201        public static BolusOption fromId(int id) {
202            for (BolusOption o : values()) {
203                if (o.id() == id) {
204                    return o;
205                }
206            }
207            return null;
208        }
209    }
210
